description:
Xcode for Windows. Write, build, preview and debug Swift on Windows, and build, sign and install iPhone apps.

XWinCode is a free and open-source Swift IDE for Windows. It edits, builds, runs and debugs Swift programs with the official toolchain, previews SwiftUI views live on 35 iPhone and iPad models and on a real iPhone, and builds, signs and installs iPhone apps through xtool in WSL, without a Mac.
